name: atl-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, Trello and Atlassian Admin (Cloud and Data Center) for Node.js, Bun and Deno, built on the atl Rust core

scripts.build:ts: bun build ./ts/index.ts --outdir dist --target node --format cjs --packages external && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:ts
